cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a landscaping yard — stacked rocks, a wheelbarrow, gravel piles and a half-finished stone garden path
cuts.scene: she is the head landscaper standing with a hand on her hip, looking over the finished stone garden path
cuts.outfit: a landscaper look fitted to her body — a short-sleeved work shirt tied at the waist and short work shorts with boots and gloves, bare legs, a gold-stitched work glove tag
